vllm_cache_limit: vLLM qwen3.5-9b returned prompt_tokens_details = null on all 45 rows (0/45 reported), so every vLLM uncached figure above is GROSS prompt tokens, an upper bound; rows carry cached_reported:false. Only occamy-1.0-NVFP4 reports cached tokens (47/48 rows).
assumptions: qwen3.5-9b: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false was NOT sent on the 90-request design run (the card named that flag for SGLang only); 27/42 base vLLM rows came back empty because thinking consumed the 300-token budget. The 10 repair rows carry thinking_off:true and instrument:'repair: ...' so they are separable from the base rows.

runs at C0F turn 4 are self-contained (system carries the full set, user message is the question), so the 3 repaired qwen C0F rows are the same prompt the arm would have sent, not a substitute transcript.
T1..T3 instructions kept the PREREG turn plan verbatim in wording; only the pointer syntax @knowledge:kNN@1 was rendered as 'knowledge item kNN' in the C0F/C0FT arms, which have no resolver.
vLLM R ran the text FETCH protocol (image refuses tool_choice auto), so the two pointer arms are not protocol-identical; this caveat carries over from C0-BASELINE.
no item was exempted from truncation because nothing needed truncating; had it been needed, k01 (the fact item) would have been kept, since dropping it would rebuild the predecessor's design defect.
